phase_1.title: Phase 1 · FAMAS F1 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.56×45mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 380 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 380 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 488 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 3-groove bore and accelerates to 960 m/s (1640 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Lever Retardation & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, unequal-arm delay lever multiplies carrier inertia to hold breech lockup during peak chamber pressure.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 25-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the FAMAS F1 staged for its 900–1,000 RPM cyclic (with 3-round burst limiter) cadence.

zh.headline: 法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪：1978 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 绰号「军号」（Le Clairon）的法国 FAMAS F1 是世界上最著名的杠杆延迟半自由枪机无托步枪：借助机匣内一对呈杠杆放大比的摆动延迟臂，无需导气孔即可在 757 mm 短小机身内稳定输出 1,000 发/分惊人射速。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：FAMAS F1 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1978 年问世的 法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪 由法国圣艾蒂安兵工厂（MAS / GIAT）主导研制，定位为经典的无托式突击步枪。自 1978 年正式列装法国陆军以来，FAMAS 在海湾战争、马里与阿富汗等海外行动中服役近四十年，是世界四大经典军用无托步枪之一。
绰号「军号」（Le Clairon）的法国 FAMAS F1 是世界上最著名的杠杆延迟半自由枪机无托步枪：借助机匣内一对呈杠杆放大比的摆动延迟臂，无需导气孔即可在 757 mm 短小机身内稳定输出 1,000 发/分惊人射速。 整件装备总长 757 mm（全长仅卡宾尺码 · 却配 488 mm 长枪管）、空重 3.61 kg，成为同期无托式步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1978 年，法国圣艾蒂安兵工厂（MAS / GIAT）推出了划时代的法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪。自 1978 年正式列装法国陆军以来，FAMAS 在海湾战争、马里与阿富汗等海外行动中服役近四十年，是世界四大经典军用无托步枪之一。 它的核心设计聚焦于短臂受压、长臂推框的机械延迟杠杆将高压枪机初退速度按杠杆比大幅减速，奠定了其在无托式步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「基拉伊式杠杆延迟半自由枪机（Lever-Delayed Blowback）· 浮置槽弹膛」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，不等臂延迟杠杆放大机框惯性阻力，延缓弹壳初抽直至膛压跌入安全窗口，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。无导气活塞结构使重心贴近肩窝，且拉机柄居中置顶、抛壳口可左右互换，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪 采用基拉伊式杠杆延迟半自由枪机（Lever-Delayed Blowback）· 浮置槽弹膛。在每个击发周期中，不等臂延迟杠杆放大机框惯性阻力，延缓弹壳初抽直至膛压跌入安全窗口。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了无导气活塞结构使重心贴近肩窝，且拉机柄居中置顶、抛壳口可左右互换。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.56×45mm NATO 弹药规格与 488 mm 浮置枪管（3 条右旋膛线 · 305 mm / 1:12 缠距），最高工作膛压约 380 MPa，可赋予弹头 960 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,640 J 动能，有效作用距离达 450 米。
内膛技术特点方面，罕见 3 条膛线配浮置槽弹膛，专适法制钢壳 M193 规格 5.56mm 弹药。同时，一体式高耸提把内藏拉机柄并集成双侧可折叠轻型两脚架，令其在 900–1,000 发/分（支持 3 发高速点射） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 488 毫米身管与 5.56×45mm NATO 口径，法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪 实现了每秒 960 米的初速与 450 米有效射程。罕见 3 条膛线配浮置槽弹膛，专适法制钢壳 M193 规格 5.56mm 弹药，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 25 发容量的25 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 46 mm 膛轴设计，法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.9 N·s 水平。独创枪托底部独立 3 发点射限制器，驯服每分钟千发的极高理论射速。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-42）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 25 发容量的25 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，独创枪托底部独立 3 发点射限制器，驯服每分钟千发的极高理论射速。欢迎在 BAY-42 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 法国 MAS FAMAS F1 无托突击步枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the FAMAS F1
paragraphs: Introduced in 1978 by Manufacture d’Armes de Saint-Étienne (MAS) in France, the MAS FAMAS F1 emerged as a defining Bullpup Assault Rifle. Issued to the French Armed Forces in 1978, the FAMAS served across four decades of global deployments as one of the world’s defining first-generation military bullpups.

Nicknamed “Le Clairon” (The Bugle), France’s FAMAS F1 pairs a compact 757 mm bullpup chassis with a Kiraly-style lever-delayed blowback bolt—eliminating gas ports while sustaining up to 1,000 RPM with a built-in 3-round burst limiter. Measuring 757 mm (Carbine Length with Full 488 mm Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 3.61 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1978, Manufacture d’Armes de Saint-Étienne (MAS) of France introduced the MAS FAMAS F1. Issued to the French Armed Forces in 1978, the FAMAS served across four decades of global deployments as one of the world’s defining first-generation military bullpups. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Mechanical-advantage delay lever transfers early bolt thrust into accelerated carrier travel — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the MAS FAMAS F1 sits its Kiraly Lever-Delayed Blowback · Fluted Chamber & High-Rate 1,000 RPM Bullpup. Throughout every firing cycle, unequal-arm delay lever multiplies carrier inertia to hold breech lockup during peak chamber pressure, containing 380 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Ambidextrous top-mounted charging handle and reversible left/right ejection port covers, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The MAS FAMAS F1 relies on Kiraly Lever-Delayed Blowback · Fluted Chamber & High-Rate 1,000 RPM Bullpup. During each cycle, unequal-arm delay lever multiplies carrier inertia to hold breech lockup during peak chamber pressure. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Ambidextrous top-mounted charging handle and reversible left/right ejection port covers.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.56×45mm NATO with 488 mm Free-Floated Barrel (3-Groove RH · 1:12" Twist · Fluted Chamber), the MAS FAMAS F1 develops 960 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,640 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 450 meters.

Internally, Distinctive 3-groove rifling and fluted chamber originally tuned for French steel-cased M193 5.56mm rounds. Combined with its 900–1,000 RPM cyclic (with 3-round burst limiter) tempo, Signature full-length carry handle shields the cocking handle and integrates folding bipod legs, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.56×45mm NATO through its 488 millimeter bore, the MAS FAMAS F1 achieves 960 meters per second and 450 meters of effective reach. Distinctive 3-groove rifling and fluted chamber originally tuned for French steel-cased M193 5.56mm rounds.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 25-round 25-round detachable magazine body with a 46 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 4.9 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Independent buttstock burst limiter tames 1,000 RPM cyclic fire into tight 3-round bursts.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-42), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
